title: KPI Floating Solar, Kadana Dam (110 MW) — MIS Dashboard (Live)
name: Floating Solar · Kadana Dam · 110 MW

calendar._comment: day 1 of the working-day axis = earliest planned start in VisiLean (06-Mar-2026). The schedule works all seven days - Sundays carry 372 of the 3,170 activity starts - so nothing is treated as a weekly off.

_baselineMode_comment: VisiLean holds no baseline dates for this project (0 of 3,508 rows, checked 17-Sep-2026). 'planned' = the VisiLean planned dates ARE the baseline and rows are not flagged un-baselined. Switch to 'visilean' once the team sets a baseline.
_activityTypeFromDepartment_comment: every row carries taskType 'Construction', so it says nothing; Engineering / Procurement - Supply / Construction are derived from the Department custom field instead, which is what the EPC bifurcation and the S-curve disciplines read

departments._comment: VisiLean 'Department' custom field -> dashboard department key

_area_comment: VisiLean carries no location or zone on any row in this project, so every activity falls into one area and the Plant Layout page shows a single tile. Add areaFromLevel3 / plantLayout here if the team starts tagging arrays.
_execStage_comment: stage buckets for the Stage progress card. A floating plant has no piling: the equivalent work is float assembly, sub-array build-up and mooring, so those get their own bucket. First match wins, so the specific keys sit above the generic ones.
_statSteps_comment: the statutory tracker cards need this project's own approval names; left empty until the Regulatory activities are named in VisiLean
_countSummaries_comment: Final Acceptance document counts (92 'Final Acceptance' + 11 'Final Acceptance on System Study' activities) and PO Placement counts (26 packages) both resolve in this schedule, so the KP count-summary cards work as they do on NTPC
_procDatesCard_comment: as on NTPC: the pipeline table replaces the Key Procurement Dates matrix on the procurement pages
_actionsRunsApi_comment: best-effort, public API: lets the Refresh button say whether this project's sync worker is running. Purely informational - the click always reloads.
_sync_comment: the workflow that keeps this dashboard fed; the page asks GitHub about it only when a build is old enough to question (checkSyncHealth)
